item.title: White dwarf stars come in a surprising number of colors, study finds
item.description: Turns out these remnants of dying stars are not all white – a new study finds that they can come in a wide array of colors, from salmon pink to chartreuse.
item.content:encoded: Turns out these remnants of dying stars are not all white – a new study finds that they can come in a wide array of colors, from salmon pink to chartreuse.

item.title: A fiery end to a NASA mission that captured some of the universe's brightest events
item.description: NASA's Swift observatory is set to re-enter the atmosphere on Wednesday after two decades of gathering data.
item.content:encoded: NASA's Swift observatory is set to re-enter the atmosphere on Wednesday after two decades of gathering data.

item.title: 4 volunteers who lived in a Mars simulation for a year are back to the real world
item.description: Four volunteers who lived and worked in a simulated NASA Mars mission for more than a year exited their habitat Saturday.

item.title: Inside the race between Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos for control of outer space
item.description: The Atlantic writer Josh Tyrangiel says Musk and Bezos each want to colonize the moon, mine its resources and launch thousands more satellites. He says their only real competition is each other.

item.title: NASA's Mars rover Perseverance has broken a landmark distance record
item.description: NASA's Mars rover Perseverance has just hit a milestone — for the longest distance traveled by an off-Earth vehicle.
item.content:encoded: NASA's Mars rover Perseverance has just hit a milestone — for the longest distance traveled by an off-Earth vehicle.

item.title: Margaret Hamilton, whose software sent humans to the moon, dies at 90
item.description: Hamilton was in her early thirties when she led the team of software engineers that powered NASA's Apollo missions. She later said, "There was no choice but to be pioneers."

item.title: 4 people on NASA's Crew-12 mission return to Earth after 8 months in space
item.description: Four people — two NASA astronauts, one from the European Space Agency and a Russian cosmonaut — spent nearly eight months at the space station, conducting spacewalks, science experiments and research.

item.description: The crew of four — two NASA astronauts, one from Canada, and a Russian cosmonaut — heads to the International Space Station after liftoff from the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida.
